title: Add visitors to the end of the reservation list
goal: uses push to append array elements, distinguishing between the appended array and the length returned by push.
summary: Visitors must be placed at the end of the reservation list after registration. The code calling the function needs to get the entire updated list.
tasks: complete addBooking(bookings, guest). Append the guest name guest to the end of the bookings array.
returns the appended list. The first visitor can also be added to the empty list, and visitors with the same name will still be added in the order of registration.

example.note: push writes the purchased items to the end of the array and returns the updated number of elements. To get two items, read supplies.

hint: return bookings.push(guest) will hand over the number of guests to the caller. First append the visitor and then return the bookings array.
